author: qwen3-coder-next
kind: three team exports (CSV, 80 to 110 tickets each) with cross-team links in different formats (one team uses "blocks", one "depends_on", one free text "needs X-123"), a program milestone doc and each team's own one-paragraph status
scenario: A director asks for one program status across the three teams for the exec review, with the real state rather than what each team says.
seeds: (1) each team reports green on its own, but a cross-team chain makes the program amber or red; (2) the link formats differ, and one critical link is only in free text; (3) a duplicate ticket counted in two teams' points; (4) one team's velocity in its status paragraph contradicts its own export; (5) a decoy: a red-looking ticket in one team that is off the program path.
